title: The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality and original-data rigidity
main_claim: Take smooth 3D initial data with one spherical asymptotically AdS end (Lambda=-3) that satisfies the DEC and the stated decay and integrability assumptions, has a weakly future outer trapped boundary, and has a future-timelike hyperbolic metric four-flux. For such data m_AH >= (r_A + r_A^3)/2, where r_A = sqrt(A_min/4pi) and A_min is the infimum of area over full enclosing cuts. In the connected, outermost, outer-area-minimizing horizon subclass, equality holds iff the data embed as a spacelike slice of Schwarzschild-AdS with M = m_AH, with boundary on the future horizon.
sibling_notes: The family-260 board had four no_gap_found reports. They cover: the maximal AH Penrose paper (rank 49), whose cubic budget via flux saturation and Jensen has the same structure as this paper's Sec 3; the boundary-graph spacetime Penrose paper (rank 87); the enclosing-area/charge paper (rank 136); and the conformal-flow RPI paper (rank 94). They mattered in two ways. They confirmed that the cubic-term mechanism and the flat generalized-Jang deformation are shared machinery checked elsewhere at the algebra level. They also showed that none of the siblings fully re-derived the existence/floor PDE either, so that shared dependency remains the main unaudited risk across the family.
